# Murali Kummitha (muralik.in)

> Personal site and blog of Murali Kummitha (Murali K), a Staff Software Engineer in Bengaluru with 12+ years in agentic AI systems, distributed systems, data platforms and fintech.

## About
- [About Murali Kummitha](https://muralik.in/about.html): background, career timeline and contact links.

## Writing
- [Upgrades on autopilot with AI agents](https://muralik.in/posts/2026-11-25-agentic-upgrades/): finding out-of-date services across a fleet, fixing them with AI agents, MCP skills and headless Claude Code, and closing the loop on merge.
- [Rails with PostgreSQL views](https://muralik.in/posts/2020-09-15-rails-postgres-views.md/): versioned PostgreSQL views behind ActiveRecord models with the Scenic gem.
- [Top engineering blogs to follow](https://muralik.in/posts/2020-08-20-top-engineering-blogs.md/): a curated list of tech company engineering blogs.
- [Multiple MySQL versions with Homebrew](https://muralik.in/posts/2020-08-17-multiple-mysql-versions.md/): installing and switching MySQL versions on macOS.
- [Template rendering with dynamic context](https://muralik.in/posts/20-08-15-dynamic-context-with-ruby/): ERB templates with Ruby Binding and OpenStruct.
